source: Adoulis, 'International coalition aircraft kill and wound fishermen in the Red Sea, and cholera spreads in Denkalia' (3 October 2016), citing the website of the Eritrean Islamic Reform Movement and other sources
processing_notes: Source states: 'يتفشى وباء الكوليرا القاتل في أنحاء واسعة من إقليم جنوب البحر الأحمر حيث تم رصد أكثر من 45 حالة في مديرتي بدا وقلعلو في دنكاليا وسط تكتم حكومي وقلة الطواقم الطبية [Translation: the deadly cholera epidemic is spreading in wide parts of the Southern Red Sea region, where more than 45 cases have been recorded in the two districts of Bada and Qal'alo (Gelalo) in Denkalia, amid government secrecy and a shortage of medical staff]' - interpreted as 45 sCh cases. WRITTEN BY AGENT 2 (geographic expansion), Opus 5.5 cycle, 2026-10-01. Interpreted as a LOWER BOUND of 45 suspected cholera cases ('more than 45') in Bada and Gelalo, Gelalo sub-zoba (geoBoundaries ADM2 'Ghelaelo'), Semenawi Keyih Bahri zoba - the source's 'Southern Red Sea' is corrected to Northern Red Sea on WHO Eritrea 2007 ('Bada, Gelalo sub Zoba of Northern Red Sea') and OpenStreetMap ('Bada Health center, ... Northern Red Sea'); same location as the 2007 rows 30-35. TL 2016-09-17 is an estimate chosen to start after Adoulis' 16 Sep report, which named only Gash-Barka and Debub; TR = day before the 3 Oct 2016 article. Provincial subset - do not sum with national row 11 (2016-08-27..2016-09-25, deaths only, which this row overlaps in time). RELATION TO NATIONAL ROW 123 (300 cases, Gash-Barka and Debub only, to 16 Sep): these 45 cases are in a DIFFERENT zoba and a later window, so they are NOT contained in row 123; the disclosed national case lower bound by early October is therefore about 345 (not written as a separate row - it would combine two sources). Third affected zoba of the 2016 episode (with Gash-Barka and Debub), matching the UN SR's 'three of the country's six regions'. Level 4, second-hand - confidence 0.15.
retracted_reason: Agent 2 2026-10-01: superseded by Index 128 - row 127 (Adoulis 3 Oct 2016, metadata 175, 'more than 45 cases', no deaths) is a derivative of the Red Sea Afar Democratic Organisation statement of 1 Oct 2016, now cited from its origin publication (farajat.net 3 Oct 2016, metadata 176: 5 deaths + more than 45 other infected in Bada, Gelalo sub-zoba). Keeping both would double-count one event at one location.
